title: Boston Dynamics redesigns Atlas’s hand for mass production
teaser: Boston Dynamics has redesigned Atlas’s hand around a constraint many humanoid builders still avoid: making it practical to manufacture and repair at scale. The new version has four fingers and 13 degrees of freedom, up from seven in the previous design. It gives up a little human resemblance in exchange for larger, more powerful actuators, replaceable modules and a path toward producing 100,000 hands a year.
